reason: Native Claude question option previews are preserved as multiline plain text with a 4000-code-point bound and rendered under their choices by Companion Apps. Overlong previews remain terminal-only while choices still route. Outbound submissions retain previews only when the service advertises choice_previews, and existing push content fetching restores previews omitted for payload size. Reviewed lifecycle hooks, the Notifai skill, harness setup, CLI readiness and domain terms: routing, answer custody and agent actions stay unchanged, so the existing native-question instructions remain accurate. The release-authored guidance note explains the added content preservation. The permissive output QuestionView also declares preview for typed consumers; older response validators already allow unknown optional choice fields.
